# pantechdynamics_access_policy_attachment (Resource)

Attaches an access policy, your own or a Pantech-managed one (pol_pantech_*), to a member or a team. Every argument replaces the attachment. Destroying it detaches the policy. At most 10 policies per member and per team. Only an owner may attach a policy to an admin, or to a team holding one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pantechdynamics_team" "developers" {
  name = "Developers"
}

# A Pantech-managed policy attaches like your own.
data "pantechdynamics_access_policy" "developer" {
  id = "pol_pantech_developer"
}

resource "pantechdynamics_access_policy_attachment" "developers" {
  policy_id      = data.pantechdynamics_access_policy.developer.id
  principal_type = "team"
  principal_id   = pantechdynamics_team.developers.id
}

# Or straight to one member.
resource "pantechdynamics_access_policy_attachment" "auditor" {
  policy_id      = "pol_pantech_read_only"
  principal_type = "member"
  principal_id   = "usr_06ggf8abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_id` (String) Id of the policy (pol_..., or a managed pol_pantech_... such as pol_pantech_developer).
- `principal_id` (String) Id of the member (usr_...) or the team (team_...).
- `principal_type` (String) "member" or "team".

### Read-Only

- `attached_at` (String) When the policy was attached, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `id` (String) "<policy_id>/<principal_type>/<principal_id>".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An attachment is imported as "<policy_id>/<principal_type>/<principal_id>".
terraform import pantechdynamics_access_policy_attachment.developers pol_pantech_developer/team/team_06ggf7abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw
```
